title: Three of 15 CHIME repeaters show full-record DM trends, but selected controls limit physical claims
abstract: We screen CHIME/FRB Catalog 2 release 20251231 with daily median dispersion measures (DM). Fifteen repeaters pass time-coverage cuts. Three show full-record time associations at permutation q below 0.01 under exchangeability. FRB 20190117A reverses slope sign in the later half. FRB 20220529A and FRB 20220912A keep their directions, with slopes of -1.224 and 1.941 pc cm^-3 yr^-1. No single day reverses these signs. However, a seven-property fit for the former and a high-S/N cut for the latter give 95% HC3 intervals that include zero. These are exploratory, conditional tests. Prior work already reports the decline in FRB 20220529A and burst-shape bias in FRB 20220912A. Independent evidence does not confirm our positive full-year slope. We report a reproducible robustness audit, not a new physical DM change. Code, selected data, all fit tables, raw provenance, figures and offline instructions are included.
